verdict.rationale: Simular's docs describe an open-source framework for computer-control agents (simular-docs-4), and a community Simulang Recipes repo of scripts you can clone (simular-docs-3). The core Sai product, though, is presented as a hosted cloud agent with an API, SDK and MCP server, and nothing shows its source is open. missing for 10: named open license, a link to the source repository, evidence that Sai's own code is published, independent corroboration.
